featured_reviews.name: Pawan Dawra
featured_reviews.review_text: Last month, I was the victim of online fraud involving your agent, Sachin Singh, who claimed to represent HDFC Bank. He offered me a loan of Rs 10 lakhs against my car and an additional Rs 7 lakhs to help me start my business. I explained my health condition and my urgent need for funds. After several phone conversations, he assured me there would be no issues with the loan process. Initially, I was paying Rs 16K for a 10 lakh HDFC car loan, but I am now paying Rs 29,000 for the same amount. After the Rs 10 lakh loan was approved, he said he would process the Rs 7 lakh loan for my business. During the process, I discovered he was actually from Bada Finance, not HDFC, which was very concerning as I was already deeply involved in the loan process. He instructed me to share an OTP and click on a link to submit my application, assuring me it was necessary. Trusting him, I followed his instructions. After the loan was processed, Rs 7 lakhs was paid to HDFC, and I was supposed to receive the remaining Rs 2.98 lakhs. However, I only received Rs 1.39 lakhs, with the rest paid in small amounts. I did not receive Rs 46,000 because I was unknowingly enrolled in a Hero Cop scheme. Upon review, I realized that by clicking all the options in the link, as instructed by Sachin Singh, I had unknowingly accepted this scheme. He pressured me to act quickly, saying there was no time to read the details. As a result, I am now paying Rs 29,000 per month without justification, while also managing expensive medical treatment. This experience has been distressing, and I do not want anyone else to go through the same situation. I will continue to raise awareness and share my experience with others.
